claim.statement: Unsupported or approximated Kubernetes features are reported, not silently ignored; dropped items include NetworkPolicy, PVC, CRDs, sidecars (only the first container imports), liveness probes, non-HTTP readiness probes, valueFrom env, and ConfigMap/Secret wiring.

sources.quote: (NetworkPolicy, PersistentVolumeClaim, CRDs) lands in the report's Dropped list
ConfigMaps and Secrets: not wired into workloads
sidecars: only the first container is imported;
Matching on label selectors, the way Kubernetes itself does, is planned

claim.measurable: Apply a manifest with a NetworkPolicy, PVC, CRD instance, a 2-container pod, livenessProbe, envFrom/valueFrom, a ConfigMap-backed env; each appears in the Dropped or warnings list and is not applied; import --strict exits non-zero on any warning; same-name apps in two namespaces become [app.NAMESPACE-NAME] with a warning; Services are matched to Deployments by name, not by label selector.
